import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Focus on the documentation-related columns
documentation_columns = [
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Vision_Document',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Requirements_Lists',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Goal_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Use_Case_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Prototypes',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_User_Stories',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_BDD_Scenarios',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_MLCanvas',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Notebooks'
]

# Count the frequency of each documentation method
documentation_counts = df[documentation_columns].apply(pd.value_counts).sum()

# Display the most frequently used documentation method
most_frequent_documentation = documentation_counts.idxmax()
most_frequent_documentation_count = documentation_counts.max()

most_frequent_documentation, most_frequent_documentation_count

import numpy as np

# Create a contingency table with the counts of each documentation method

    'Counts': documentation_counts
}).reset_index()

# Perform the chi-squared test
